paletteDescriptions.flattenTree: Collapses all branches into one list.
paletteDescriptions.graftTree: Puts every item on its own branch.
paletteDescriptions.recordField: Reads one authored key off a record value.

paletteDescriptions.castValue: Asserts the value already matches the target base type.
paletteDescriptions.convertUnit: Converts a quantity from one unit to another (mm → m, …).
paletteDescriptions.coalesceValue: Falls back to a replacement when the value is empty or missing.
paletteDescriptions.requireValue: Fails the run when the value is missing or null.
paletteDescriptions.validateValue: Checks the value against required/pattern/min/max rules.
paletteDescriptions.shiftList: Shifts list items by an offset.
paletteDescriptions.partitionList: Splits a list into fixed-size branches.
paletteDescriptions.branchTree: Extracts one branch by its path.
paletteDescriptions.zipTrees: Pairs two trees item by item.
paletteDescriptions.unzipTree: Splits a zipped tree back into two.
paletteDescriptions.treeStats: Branch/item counts and depth of a tree.
paletteDescriptions.field: Declare a field on a class.
paletteDescriptions.construct: Create entities of a bound type.
paletteDescriptions.transition: Move entities to a target state.
paletteDescriptions.contextEntity: The entity the current action runs on.
paletteDescriptions.allEntities: Every entity of a bound type.
paletteDescriptions.pinnedEntity: One authored instance reference — the exact record, wired into ref inputs.
paletteDescriptions.getField: Read one field off each entity.
paletteDescriptions.selectValue: Pick one of two values by a boolean condition.
paletteDescriptions.mergeRecords: Shallow-merge two records; the right side wins.
paletteDescriptions.waitUntil: Pause the flow until a date-time, then continue.
paletteDescriptions.emitEvent: Emit a typed event to other processes.
paletteDescriptions.eventPayload: Read a field off the event that started this flow.
